description:
With shimmering colors, magical bubbles, and a splash of imagination, every ride feels like an underwater adventure. The Huffy Mermaid Bubble Scooter Ride-On transforms driveways and sidewalks into enchanted seas where little riders can cruise, play, and let their imaginations swim free. Every press of the throttle brings new smiles, confidence, and magical moments.
Simple controls and a stable three-wheel design help young riders feel comfortable from the very beginning. The easy push-button throttle lets kids cruise at a gentle speed of up to 2 MPH, while the wide rear wheels provide extra balance as they learn to steer and explore. It's a fun, confidence-building way to encourage outdoor play.
The built-in motorized bubble blower adds an extra touch of magic by creating a stream of bubbles as kids ride, with bubble solution included to get the fun started right away. A rechargeable 6V battery and charger keep adventures going, making every ride a chance to create unforgettable memories filled with laughter, imagination, and outdoor fun.
